# Final Student Dashboard

The real Aliko Academy LMS with all 9 WABON units, every lesson, video, Pyramid and Story activity, discussion, quiz, skill and clinical hour built in.

Aliko Academy · Health · CNA (NA-C) Training Program

Audience: LMS team, Program Director, instructors

Based on a live walkthrough of lms.alikohub.com (Nov 23, 2026), the WABON Common Curriculum (Units

1–9) and WAC 246-841A (effective July 1, 2026)

Version 1.0 · November 23, 2026

## What this document shows

Each page shows one student screen as it will look once the WABON curriculum is fully built into the LMS. The screens use the real LMS design (logo, menu names, colors, cards and fonts) captured from lms.alikohub.com, and the real course content: unit titles, WABON video titles, Student Guide pages, the five characters and the 22 tested skills. Red numbered circles on each screen are explained underneath it in plain language.

## What we keep from the live LMS

The menu structure and names (Main, Training & Curriculum, Community & Support, Achieve, Account), the greeting and dark hero card, the three progress rings, the theory seat-time "heartbeat" that pauses when the tab loses focus, instructor-only attendance and skills sign-off, the proctoring rules, and the Clinical page's 10:1 and 40-hour rules. The menu item "Peer Grading" is removed because WABON requires instructor grading.

## S1 · Student Dashboard — fully integrated

The real dashboard layout (greeting, dark hero card, progress rings, active courses, study activity) is kept.   
What changes is that every card is now filled with the WABON course structure.

![](data:image/jpeg;base64,)

## How this page works — red numbers match the screen

## Continue where you left off

The big dark card always takes the student to the exact next item in the current unit (here Unit 6, lesson 6, the Carol & Daniel story). One click on "Resume lesson" opens the course player at that item.

## Your progress

Three rings show the three WABON hour types: theory (35 h), skills (22 tested skills) and clinical (40 h). Lab hours (33 h) are shown below. Numbers come from verified seat-time, instructor check-offs and signed clinical shifts, never from the student ticking boxes.

## 3-month window

WAC 246-841A requires asynchronous theory to be completed within 3 months. The countdown starts on the cohort start date and turns orange at 21 days and red at 7 days.

## My course path

All 9 WABON units in the real order and with their real titles, plus Orientation (Module 0) at the top and Mock skills / Clinical / Exam prep at the bottom. A unit unlocks only when the previous unit's quiz is passed and its scheduled open date arrives.

## Due this week

Every graded item for this week in one list: activities, discussion, quiz, lab day and live sessions. Each row opens the item directly.

## Study activity

Shows verified theory minutes per day. The timer runs only while the lesson tab is in focus (the live LMS already has this "heartbeat").

## How this page works — red numbers match the screen

## 1 Gate status

The live LMS has 3 orientation items; the final version has 9 (O-1 to O-9), matching the WABON orientation deck and the Workforce Board disclosure rules. Unit 1 stays locked until all 9 are done.

Orientation time is tracked but is not counted toward the 35 theory hours, so the 108-hour total stays exact.

Attendance is marked by the instructor in the Attendance Census. The student cannot tick it themselves (this rule is already in the live LMS and is kept).

## Enrollment agreement

The signed agreement (with the Workforce Board refund policy) is stored in the student record and is visible to the admin and the WABON reviewer.

![](data:image/jpeg;base64,)

## S3 · My Learning — all 9 units in one view

Today the "My Learning" page is empty for students. The final version shows the whole course at a glance.

## How this page works — red numbers match the screen

## Units tab

Nine unit cards with the exact WABON titles, hours, Student Guide pages and the characters used in that unit's Story activities. Each card shows the number of videos, the Pyramid activity, the discussion and the quiz. Clicking a card opens that unit in the course player.

## 2 After the 9 units

Mock skills (8 h of the 33 lab hours), Clinical (40 h) and Exam prep follow in order and unlock automatically when the previous step is complete.

## S4 · Course player — Unit 6 lesson flow

The real course player (top breadcrumb, left lesson list, seat-time box) is kept. The left list now shows the complete Unit 6 flow with every WABON video and activity.

## UNIT 6 · L7 · UNIT DISCUSSION

## Joseph's blood pressure is much higher than his baseline

## Your post 1

Posted Feb 16 · 3:02 PM

I would re-check the blood pressure with the right cuff size after Joseph has rested for five minutes, and ask how he is feeling. would report the reading and any symptoms such as headache or dizziness to the nurse right away, because changes from baseline are outside my scope to judge. I would record the time, the arm used, the position and the reading in the flow sheet

## Meron A. MA

Good point about letting him rest first. I would also check that his feet are flat and his arm is at heart level, because that changes the reading.

## Daniel K. (dк

I agree we report and don't decide. Should we also tell Joseph his number, or leave that to the nurse?

30 min theory  Graded - discussion rubric

Reply to a classmate

POINTS

Stays within NA scope of practice 3

Uses course terms correctly 2

Two respectful, substantive replies 3

Posted on time

business days and posts a wrap-up summary when the unit

## How this page works — red numbers match the screen

## Post first

Students write their own answer before they can see classmates' posts. Each unit uses the discussion question built from that unit's characters.

## Reply requirement

Two replies are required. This is the student-to-student interaction that WABON's asynchronous standards ask for.

## Rubric

The same rubric is shown to the student and used by the instructor in Submissions, so grading is transparent.

## Instructor presence

Instructor replies and wrap-ups give the documented student-to-instructor interaction required for online theory.

## How this page works — red numbers match the screen

## Start checks

Before each quiz the LMS verifies photo ID, turns on the webcam and microphone, and asks for the honor code. This is how the program meets WABON's rule that online tests must confirm who the student is.

## Question view

Questions are drawn from a pool, the timer is visible, and the student sees which questions are answered.

## Recording and tab-blur

Leaving the tab is logged and sent to the instructor's and admin's integrity review (Admin → Compliance & Audits → Exam Session Integrity).
